Description:
Requests to read a number of bytes of data from the socket connection for the RawDataStream
defined by the instance.
If Multicast Credentials are defined for the client, the data shall be read from the multicast socket
created in the constructor (for 1:N use cases), otherwise the data shall be read from the unicast
TCP socket connection set up in Connect() (for 1:1 TCP unicast use case), or the unicast UDP
socket created in the constructor (for 1:1 UDP unicast use case).
For efficiency, the zero-copy semantics of std::unique_ptr is used, which means that the
ownership of the allocated memory of the read data is transferred to the application in the Read
DataResult.data value.
